Try it: paste one chunk — a treatment or character notes.

It takes a few minutes in order — 1/3 characters and places → 2/3 details and scenes → 3/3 composition and prompt per cut — and keeps running if you close the window. The answers go straight into the draft, and with «Write detailed prompts per card (4/4)» on (the default), the character and place sheet prompts and each cut's image and video prompts are then requested from the LLM card by card — it costs time and money per card, so it can be turned off.
해 볼 것: «만들기» 를 누르고 창을 닫아 두세요. «넣고 이미지·영상: Try it: press «Create» and close the window. Try it: press «Set traits» and skim what comes back.

Write only what changes under «Elements to change and new traits» and generate the prompt.

Try it: click a cut to expand it.

컷 머리줄의 «구도잡기» 를 누르면 3D 창이 열립니다. 왼쪽 위에 «3: Press «Composition Planner» in the cut header to open the 3D window. Top left: «3D layout» and ratio chips (1:1 … 21:9), then the «Layout» «Environment» «Timeline» tabs below; top right: «Place on floor» «Floor» «Save composition». The bottom of the screen is the camera-move timeline.
Try it: press «Composition Planner» and pick 16:9 from the ratio chips.

Indoor takes width, depth and ceiling height as numbers; outdoor takes one radius. Cyclorama is a product-shot studio joined by a single color, with no images.
해 볼 것: «실내» 를 누르고 가로 5 · 깊이 4 · 층고 2.7 로: Try it: press «Indoor» and set width 5 · depth 4 · ceiling 2.7.

«배치» 탭의 «인물» 목록에 이 작품의 인물이 서 있습니다. 눈 단추로: The «Characters» list in the «Layout» tab holds this project's characters. The eye button does «Remove from this cut», and «+ Male» «+ Female» add mannequins. Select a character and drag it in the view, or turn on «Place on floor» and click the floor to send it there. Keys 1 · 2 · 3 are the move, rotate and scale gizmos.
해 볼 것: 인물 하나를 고르고 방 안 어딘가에 세운 뒤 카메라를 돌려: Try it: select one character, stand it somewhere in the room, then orbit the camera (left-drag rotates · right-drag pans · wheel zooms).
몸 색은 캡처에서 누가 누구인지 가리는 유일한 표시입니다. 이름표는 그림: Body color is the only thing in a capture that tells who is who. Name tags don't go into the image; the prompt pairs them up as “the blue person is @…”.

한국어(기본) · 영어 · 일본어 · 중국어 중 하나를 고르면 화면 문구: Choose Korean (default), English, Japanese or Chinese and the UI text and tutorials switch to that language. Tutorials are turned on and off with the switch in the same place.

엔진마다 폴더가 갈립니다 — 로라는 학습한 모델에 묶여 있어 엔진이 다르: Folders are split per engine — a LoRA is tied to the model it was trained on, and loading fails outright on a different engine. Type something like «dance» or «anime style» in the search field, press «Search», then «Download» from the results. In the downloaded list, set «Strength» (1 is as trained) and «Default» (used by generations that don't pick one). «연결» 을 누르면 브라우저가 열리고 코드를 넣습니다. 연결되면 «한 번: Press «Connect» and a browser opens where you enter the code. Once connected, «Generate all» gains «Magnific — generate end-to-end» — from character sheets to scene videos with no hands on, but charged per item. The usual «Set up the generator» (generating yourself in the window) stays as it is. «Test connection» and «Disconnect» are here too.
이 컴퓨터의 GPU·빈 자리를 읽어 엔진마다 «이 기계에서 됩니다 · 줄: It reads this computer's GPU and free space and rates each engine «Runs on this machine · Runs if reduced · Tight · Won't run». «Precision» defaults to auto. «Install» sets up the Python environment; video engines (MiniMax · Wan) also download their weights in full at install time, while the others are tens of GB and download on the first generation. An installed engine has a «Prefetch weights (about N GB)» button to fetch them early. «Remove» deletes only that engine's folder. «Unload worker» frees VRAM.
«기본 목표 크기» 와 «기본» 엔진을 정하면 가위 편집 창 · 6면 세: Set the «Default target size» and «Default» engine and the «Upscale» in the scissors editor, 6-face set cards and the panorama tab uses them. When the app's default texts change, only untouched copies are swapped automatically; ones you've edited take the update only when you press «Reset to default».
«사용할 제공자» 를 고르면 그 제공자의 표가 뜹니다. 작업마다 모델(S: Choose the «Provider to use» and that provider's table appears. Each task gets a model (Sonnet 5 — balanced · Opus 5 — quality first · Haiku 4.5 — fast and cheap; GPT-5.6 Terra · Sol · Luna) and a reasoning effort (none · light · normal · deep · very deep). Each provider is saved separately, so switching back and forth to compare keeps the earlier settings. «Defaults» resets.

«다시 찍기» 단추는 없앴습니다. 저장이 곧 찍는 것이라 둘을 나눠 두면: The «Retake» button was removed. Saving is the capture; keeping them separate only left the confusion of “is capturing different from saving?”.

The bottom face is the floor, so characters don't float, and shrinking the room makes characters take up more of it and look bigger than the background. Images are generated at these numbers (meters are stamped into the prompt), so place characters, look, then settle it here.

The dome is most accurate from the center at 1.6 m eye height; move away and the floor smears.
실내만 있습니다. 누른 면만 벽이 되어 뒤를 가립니다. «방 밖에서 외벽: Indoor only. To change over time, set keys on the «Room · blocking faces · props» row in the timeline below.

Pick an already-made place from the dropdown and reopen it with «Open»; × detaches it from the room (card and images remain).

«영상 추가» 로 MP4 · WebM · MOV 를 여러 개 한 번에 넣: «Add video» takes several MP4 · WebM · MOV files at once. They're stored in the project folder; rename by double-clicking (the name shown on the timeline layer as «Suhwa (dance line…)»). Removing from the list doesn't delete the original file. The player on the right overlays the skeleton and numbers of the current frame.

Click the number to jump to their first frame. «Timeline start» is from which second this video's keys go in; «Keep formation from video» is whether, with several people, their spacing and front/back are kept as in the video.
